slides.heading: Get it checked if you notice
items: Pain spreading to arm or leg

caption:
The couch is comfy for the first 20 minutes. Then your neck starts talking 🛋️

A laptop on your lap pulls your head down and forward, and soft cushions let your lower back sag. You don't need a full home office to improve things. Raise the screen on a firm cushion or a stack of books, add a cheap wireless keyboard and mouse, and sit into the corner of the couch with a cushion behind your back.

Better still, switch spots through the day: dining table, couch, kitchen bench.

Pain spreading into an arm or leg, building headaches, or stiffness that isn't easing after a week or two are worth an assessment. Our Chatswood and Sydney CBD physios can help. Book online via the link in bio.
